title: Removal of antibiotic resistance genes and co-selectors in a full-scale sewage treatment plant during droughts and floods
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,702-713
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00875H, Paper
Sourabh Dixit, Jayavignesh Vijayan, Harshita Singh, Indumathi M. Nambi, T. Renganathan, R. Ravikrishna, Gargi Singh
The 60 MLD STP failed to remove ARGs, irrespective of the weather conditions of droughts and floods. Two ARGs were selected in the maturation pond – tetW and blaOXA-1.
